hooks.command: GATE_WORKTREE="$WORKTREE_PATH"; broker_pid=$(ps -eo pid=,command= | grep 'app-server-broker.mjs' | grep -- "--cwd $GATE_WORKTREE" | awk '{print $1}'); [ -n "$broker_pid" ] && kill "$broker_pid" 2>/dev/null; make -C "$GATE_WORKTREE" db-down 2>/dev/null || true

payload=$(cat); agent_name=$(echo "$payload" | grep -o '"agent_name":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); session_id=$(echo "$payload" | grep -o '"session_id":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); echo "HOOK: SubagentStop — agent=${agent_name:-unknown} session=${session_id:-unknown} payload_size=${#payload} exited" >> /tmp/harness-hook-events.log
